name: Start clock
description: Raise one open hand above the head, then chop the arm downward to start the clock.

name: Stop clock
description: Raise one open hand above the head with the palm facing forward.

name: Stop clock for jump/held ball
description: Raise both hands with thumbs up to stop the clock for a held ball, then indicate the alternating-possession direction.

name: Stop clock for foul
description: Raise one clenched fist above the head.

name: Stop clock for foul - optional bird dog
description: Raise one clenched fist above the head and point toward the fouling player with the opposite arm.

name: Directional signal
description: Extend one arm horizontally with an open hand toward the direction of play or the awarded basket.

name: Throw-in and free-throw designated spot / violation
description: Point to the floor at the designated spot or the location of the violation.

name: Move along endline on throw-in
description: Sweep one arm horizontally along the end line to show that the thrower may move along it.

name: Visible counts
description: Extend one arm and move the forearm rhythmically while visibly counting seconds.

name: Beckoning substitutes
description: Hold one open hand up and wave it inward toward the body to beckon substitutes onto the court.

name: 60-second time-out
description: Extend both arms horizontally to the sides at shoulder height.

name: 30-second time-out
description: Place both hands on or near the shoulders with elbows extended outward.

name: Not closely guarded
description: Extend both arms horizontally to the sides to indicate that the closely guarded count does not apply.

name: Tipped ball
description: Hold both hands above the head and brush or touch the fingertips of one hand against the other.

name: Flopping
description: Hold both open hands upright in front of the torso and move both forearms downward together to indicate faking being fouled.

name: No score
description: Extend both arms horizontally and wave them side to side to cancel or deny the score.

name: Goal counts
description: Raise one arm and sweep it downward to indicate that the goal counts.

name: Points scored
description: Point toward the scorer and show one or two fingers after the goal-count signal.

name: 3-point attempt / 3-point score / 3-point made
description: For an attempt, raise one arm with three fingers extended. When made, raise both arms with three fingers extended.

name: Signal free throw
description: Raise one hand and display the number of free throws with the appropriate number of fingers.

name: Delayed violation - withheld whistle
description: Extend one arm horizontally with a closed fist and withhold the whistle until the play is completed.

name: Traveling violation
description: Rotate both clenched fists around each other in front of the body.

name: Illegal dribble
description: Move both open hands alternately up and down in a patting motion.

name: Palming / carry
description: Turn one open hand from palm down to palm up to show that the ball came to rest in the hand.

name: Backcourt / first to touch from out of bounds violation
description: Sweep one forearm across the front of the body to indicate the violation.

name: 3-second violation
description: Show three fingers, then sweep the arm across the lane area.

name: 5-second violation
description: Hold up one open hand with all five fingers extended.

name: 10-second violation
description: Hold up both open hands with all ten fingers extended.

name: Excessive swinging elbows
description: Swing a bent elbow horizontally across the body.

name: Kicking
description: Point toward the foot or make a small kicking motion with the lower leg.

name: Illegal use of hands
description: Strike or grasp the wrist of one arm with the opposite hand.

name: Hand check
description: Place one hand against the opposite forearm or wrist while the other palm faces outward.

name: Holding
description: Grasp one wrist with the opposite hand in front of the chest.

name: Blocking
description: Place both hands on the hips.

name: Pushing / charging
description: Extend both open hands forward from the chest in a pushing motion.

name: Player / team control
description: Place one hand behind the head with the elbow pointing outward.

name: Intentional foul
description: Cross both wrists above the head with clenched fists.

name: Double foul
description: Extend both arms horizontally to the sides with clenched fists.

name: Technical foul
description: Form a T by placing one hand horizontally over the other vertical hand.
